title: Request to bring Harrington to testify to House Oversight Committee

tellings.quote: but he calls me and he says, "I've been asked by Dave Grush to ask you to ask Brent if he can help us get John Harrington to Washington DC to potentially testify to the House Oversight Committee."

plain: In 2025 there was a behind-the-scenes push to get an official named John S. Herrington to Washington to testify before the House Oversight Committee, as part of the push for official hearings on UFOs. Bryce Zabel tells Michels he got a phone call, from someone he links to Ross Coulthart, saying: 'I've been asked by Dave Grush to ask you to ask Brent if he can help us get John Harrington to Washington DC to potentially testify.' David Grusch is a witness in these matters, and Brent is not identified further.
